basis: Idealized teaching example, not measured hull data: a 1.00 m cube of mass 600 kg floats in water of density 1000 kg/m^3. Its submerged prism has draft 600/(1000*1*1)=0.600 m, volume 0.600 m^3, midship area 0.600 m^2 and waterplane area 1.00 m^2. Half and double sizes are synthetic similarity transformations of this cited example.
